turns.assessment: The 400G line card trx.och152.z at S15 raised EQPT_CARD_FAIL exactly when the affected services failed. Its failure explains loss of the S15-to-S04 transmitted channel observed at S04, while the unchanged S04-to-S15 optical path and amplifiers argue strongly against a fibre, amplifier, or OMS fault. The shared impact on services carried by och152 is consistent with this card failure.

proposals.rationale: Direct equipment-card alarm at onset; the far-end S04 interface and incoming OCM lose the channel from S15, while the reverse optical line remains unchanged. A failed S15 card also interrupts traffic received locally, accounting for the bidirectional service losses.
